decisions.reason: As a prominently marketed extension of the core cloud messaging offer, transactional email fits the firm's growth direction and is likely to be retained.
Document capture and recognition supports digital document workflows for business and public-sector customers, so it remains strategically attractive despite being newer adjacent functionality.
Email and fax conversion matches the firm's multichannel communications positioning and German demand for compliant legacy-channel integration, though it is less prominently marketed.

Fax delivery optimization is close to the existing offer and useful for reliability-sensitive customers, but as a narrower feature with low visibility it has the highest risk of being discontinued or absorbed.
Email sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's secure messaging value proposition for regulated customers and therefore is likely to stay in the portfolio.
Multi-engine email virus scanning complements the firm's security-led communication services and should be kept, although its lower website prominence suggests some portfolio risk.
